title: Great if you want a whisper of air.
text: Great if you want a whisper of air.. This looked like it was going to be perfect, but even on high, I could barely feel the air. It was right next to the foot of my bed, and it was like it was on low speed. I kept checking it, but it just wouldn't get any stronger. This fan would probably be fine if you just wanted circulation, but for coolness, I wouldn't recommend!
